displayContract.byline: Assessments made by 5.6 Sol. — Rubric: Slugfester Reassessment Rubric v2.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that emergent-spacetime research modestly favors a structural foundation, and consciousness plus comparative explanatory economy may favor interpreting that foundation as a necessary mind.

novelty.explanation: This replaces a deductive transition with a cumulative, explicitly comparative inference addressing the exposed ontology gap.

premises.text: Several serious physical programs treat familiar spacetime as derivative from deeper informational, relational, or quantum structure, so ordinary spacetime need not be metaphysically fundamental.

novelty.explanation: This preserves the scientific motivation while limiting the claim to serious derivative-spacetime programs.

premises.text: A structural description alone is ontologically incomplete unless an account identifies what realizes the structure and explains why it supports conscious experience.

novelty.explanation: This accepts the relata challenge and redirects the argument toward comparative realization and consciousness.

premises.text: Mental reality is directly known to instantiate qualitative content and structured relations, making mind one candidate realizer rather than an automatic consequence of mathematical description.

novelty.explanation: This supplies a positive but defeasible mentality bridge without claiming that abstract relations entail idealism.

premises.text: A foundational mind improves the comparison only if its nature and reasons jointly compress physical regularities better than rival laws, properties, and initial conditions.

novelty.explanation: This imposes symmetric total-cost accounting on the contested parsimony argument.

premises.text: The hypothesis earns empirical support only when it independently assigns higher expectation to observed structure than to relevant alternatives and remains exposed to specified defeaters.

novelty.explanation: This develops the probabilistic response into an explicit discrimination and defeater requirement.

conclusion.text: Accordingly, theistic idealism is a live cumulative explanation only if its mental realization, divine attributes, comparative economy, and evidential expectations are independently developed and outperform nonmental structural accounts.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion proportionately conditions the original route on completing its major exposed bridges.

newArguments.title: Conscious realization test
newArguments.text: A stronger idealist route can ask which candidate foundation makes consciousness least surprising. Pure structural models specify relations and dynamics but may leave qualitative experience as an additional unexplained fact. A mental foundation begins with qualitative capacity, yet it must still explain stable public structure, finite perspectives, and lawful regularities. The comparison should therefore count unexplained transitions on both sides: nonmental structure to experience, and foundational mentality to an apparently external physical order. Idealism gains support only if the second transition is developed more economically than the first.

novelty.explanation: This introduces a symmetric transition-cost test connecting consciousness to the ontology comparison without resting on a transcript entailment.

newArguments.title: Reason-constrained divine choice
newArguments.text: The constraint objection can be answered by replacing unrestricted divine choice with a reason-governed selection model. A perfect agent would favor coherent, intelligible, stable worlds capable of supporting knowledge and responsible agency, thereby assigning lower expectation to chaotic alternatives. These constraints cannot be invented after observing the world; they must be motivated from the proposed divine nature and generate risky comparative expectations. If they do, divine agency would no longer function as permission for every outcome, and its explanatory cost could be compared directly with brute material parameters.

novelty.explanation: This directly repairs the underconstraint objection by specifying a testable role for antecedently motivated divine reasons.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that present physics supports realism about an underlying constraint-bearing structure but does not select mentality or divinity, so materialist realism remains the better disciplined default.

novelty.explanation: This consolidates the scientific underdetermination, nonmental modeling, and discrimination objections into one proportionate thesis.

premises.text: Quantum-gravity research contains important emergence programs, but no established result currently licenses a general inference from their models to an ultimately mental source.

novelty.explanation: This combines scientific caution with the limited conclusion actually supported by nonmental model content.

premises.text: Emergence is ontologically neutral by itself because higher-level spacetime may arise from nonmental quantum states or relations without becoming unreal or mental.

novelty.explanation: This develops the countermodel while avoiding reliance on a complete analogy with thermodynamics.

premises.text: Scientific success supports commitment to whatever structures and entities perform indispensable explanatory work, though it does not predetermine a classical substance ontology.

novelty.explanation: This narrows realism to warranted commitments and repairs the leap from success to traditional material substance.

premises.text: An adequate worldview should constrain expected observations through stable dynamics and boundary conditions rather than merely remain logically compatible with every possible history.

novelty.explanation: This generalizes the constraint objection into a standard applicable to both competing worldviews.

premises.text: A first explanatory source does not acquire mentality, agency, necessity, or perfection unless separate evidence establishes each additional attribute.

novelty.explanation: This preserves the attribute-gap objection while specifying the separate evidential bridges required.

conclusion.text: Therefore, absent independently supported mentality and divine-attribute bridges, the disciplined conclusion is realism about whatever nonmental structure successful physics warrants, with further ontology held open to revision.

novelty.explanation: This avoids overclaiming a specific material substance while retaining the core comparative objection to theistic idealism.

newArguments.title: Layered commitment realism
newArguments.text: Materialist realism can avoid claiming that current physics has discovered the final furniture of reality. It may instead commit in layers: strongly to stable experimentally indispensable structure, provisionally to the entities posited by successful models, and weakly to speculative quantum-gravity interpretations. This calibrated realism explains scientific success without turning every mathematical representation into literal substance. It also makes revision principled: commitments change when empirical indispensability, cross-theory stability, or explanatory contribution changes. The resulting position is realist and nonidealist while remaining appropriately cautious about the ultimate substrate.

novelty.explanation: This introduces a graded ontology of scientific commitment that strengthens realism without exceeding present physical evidence.

newArguments.title: Symmetric compression audit
newArguments.text: The parsimony dispute should be evaluated by explanatory compression rather than counting named entities. For each worldview, list foundational kinds, laws or reasons, initial conditions, mappings to experienced reality, and unexplained parameters. Then ask how much observed regularity follows without case-specific additions. A divine mind does not automatically simplify the ledger if its reasons and choices must encode the same physical detail; a material foundation does not automatically win if its constants and laws remain independent brute facts. This audit favors whichever account derives more structure from fewer independently specified commitments.

novelty.explanation: This repairs simplistic posit counting by supplying a symmetric method for comparing total explanatory commitments.
